title: Fonts
intro: WordPress 6.5 added a Font Library (Appearance → Fonts) to upload font files or install Google Fonts and make them available to the Site Editor’s typography settings.
wordpress: The Font Library lists the fonts the active theme provides, lets you upload .woff2/.ttf files, and installs fonts from Google Fonts.
backdrop: Backdrop core has no font library. Fonts are part of the theme: Basis uses system fonts; changing them means editing the theme (or a sub-theme) or installing a contrib module.
